## Speech Sounds

![](images/body.jpeg){fig-alt="Schematic of body planes" fig-align="center" width="100%"}

## Speech Sounds

We can cross-categorize them many ways

::: ipa
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-alt: |
%%|   A taxonomy of speech sounds by airstream mechanism
flowchart TD
  A[airstream] --> P[pulmonic]
  A --> G[glottalic]
  A --> V[velaric]
  P --> Pe[egressive]
  G --> Ge[egressive]
  G --> Gi[ingressive]
  V --> Vi[ingressive]
  Pe --> Pes["[p, t, k,...]"]
  Ge --> Ges["[pʼ, tʼ, kʼ, ...]"]
  Gi --> Gis["[ɓ, ɗ, ɠ, ...]"]
  Vi --> Vis["[ʘ, ǃ, ...]"]
```
:::
